title: Isolation commanded, no feedback contact fitted
description: Same break as S04, but the simulated hardware has no switch feedback contact (feedback NOT_FITTED). The relay does open, but nothing can confirm it.
what_to_look_for: Feeder: 'Isolation commanded – not confirmed', with the explanation 'No feedback contact is fitted'.
Never shown as Isolated, even though the voltages fall to zero.
No ISOLATION_UNCONFIRMED alert (there is no feedback to time out); the event records 'Cannot confirm – no feedback fitted'.
